node.title: Paper D v13.2 discrete subfield-census guard
node.statement: For C=RS[F,D,K] with D subseteq B, K<=m, 2(m-K)<=n-K, w'=m-K, w'+1<=d1<=floor((n-K+1)/2), m'=K-1+d1, and m'+d1<=n, the Paper D v13.2 identity-prefix census has A_B(d1)=C(n,m')|B|^-(d1-1), exact floor M_B^disc=C(m',m)ceil(A_B), and soft upper model M_B^soft=C(m',m)(1+A_B). The ceiling precedes support multiplication. Exact replay gives the corrected KoalaBear floors 67.0958/56.0111/43.9348/57.6849 bits and Mersenne-31 floors 52.1129/41.0169/39.1799/57.6848 bits at offsets zero through three.
